selected.edition: Silent Hill 2 original (2001), Lakeview Hotel final duo encounter
selected.phase: Two original Pyramid Heads with spears, neutral encounter composition

calibrationProposal.definition: Presentation axis between the two pelvis/support axes, independent of spear length; lowest front boot is the support baseline. Body height uses highest front helmet to lowest boot. One collective runtime profile, not two autonomous actors.

selected.review: Deux corps distincts orientés à droite ; deux casques originaux pointus, quatre bottes, quatre bras et deux lances entières. Les pointes et les talons des deux armes restent dans le PNG. Alpha réel et intervalles entre les membres contrôlés sur damier ; aucun halo visible dans la composition.
selected.limits: Un seul profil moteur collectif, deux corps dans une image ; aucun deuxième acteur autonome ajouté. Pose, côtés cachés, talons et pointes recomposés depuis des vues natives partielles et le modèle de base. La figure arrière est légèrement plus petite et plus haute dans la profondeur représentée ; ce décalage ne mesure pas le plan de sol canonique. Marge alpha32 minimale 28 px, soit 2,73 % de la hauteur : le prompt demandait 8 %, non obtenus, sans extrémité coupée. Aucune animation, synchronisation des deux corps ou fidélité 1:1 certifiée.
selected.prompt: Create ONE transparent-background raster asset for the Twin Pyramid Heads encounter from ORIGINAL Silent Hill 2 (2001), Lakeview Hotel final duo encounter. This is ONE collective roster profile represented by exactly TWO separate complete creatures in the same coherent image. Use the first two supplied native cutscene captures to identify the original sharply pointed rusty helmets, pale sleeveless stained long smocks, bare arms, dark boots and two long thin spears. The third supplied model render controls body/helmet/material only; do NOT copy its Great Knife or raised-leg pose. Compose a dedicated RIGHT-FACING LATERAL DUO: BOTH original Pyramid Heads face toward the right edge, with side-on head/torso/pelvis, in calm neutral standing poses. Place one a little ahead and one behind, slightly separated in depth so both helmets, four boots, four arms and each complete spear can be read without merging silhouettes. Each carries its OWN complete long narrow spear in a distinct natural neutral angle, with both full shafts, tips and butt ends visibly inside the frame. No Great Knife and no film/2024/Book of Memories helmet substitutions. Keep them recognizably two independent bodies in one composed encounter sprite, never a fused giant or one duplicated cutout. Both feet of each creature have a plausible shared support plane; no attack, impalement, victim, self-harm action or narrative ending. EXCLUDE the woman, cage and entire room from the reference. One duo only, no third actor, no scenery, floor, cast shadow, text, subtitles, HUD or multiple views. Detailed original-game-model-style raster, restrained diffuse light and native muted aged materials, no added blood or injury. True alpha transparency outside the two figures and through their separated limbs. Use a wide or square canvas as needed; keep the WHOLE duo and both weapons comfortably inside at least 8 percent clear margins on all four sides. This is a static lateral candidate, not a claim of source animation.

selected.phase: One attached Giant Wall Man target with its bordering membrane/support

calibrationProposal.definition: Stationary wall-support axis, independent of the four reaching arms; lower own border is the presentation baseline. Body height includes the whole attached assembly from head to bottom border, preserving the existing assembly-height convention. This is not a walking foot anchor or a measured rail position.

selected.review: Une cible attachée, tête et torse vers la droite avec léger trois-quarts pour rendre les quatre bras lisibles. Quatre mains et bordure du support entières ; aucun pied ou corps inférieur inventé. La composition sur damier montre une vraie découpe transparente autour de l’assemblage, sans rectangle de fond ni halo.
selected.limits: Le rendu source entier mesure 197×254 px et la capture de salle 250×176 px. La profondeur du cadre et le côté caché sont reconstruits, pas relevés sur modèle 3D ; le support complet de la salle et son rail ne sont pas livrés. Une seule cible représentée, pas les douze Wall Men ni leur puzzle. Marge alpha32 minimale 26 px, soit 1,83 % de la hauteur : le prompt demandait 8 %, non obtenus, mais les quatre mains et tout le bord restent visibles. canMove/canJump/canDodge restent false ; aucune animation du rail ou fidélité 1:1 certifiée.
selected.prompt: Create ONE isolated complete transparent-background raster of the One Truth / Giant Wall Man boss target from ORIGINAL Silent Hill 4: The Room (2004), based on the supplied native model render and commercial room screenshot. Represent exactly ONE of the established wall-mounted targets, with its own full bordering wall membrane and narrow supporting frame visible in the first reference, not the whole room or twelve copies. Create a dedicated RIGHT-FACING LATERAL VIEW: turn the front of the head and upper torso toward the right edge, while preserving their actual attachment to the vertical wall support behind them. A small angle is allowed to keep the FOUR source arms and the supporting border readable rather than hiding everything edge-on. Preserve the original elongated deformed head, compact dark torso emerging from the stretched ochre/rust-coloured wall surface, four long attached arms with complete hands, and the full tapered/trapezoidal wall-border silhouette from the native reference. The two thicker outer limbs and two thinner forward arms remain attached as in that model; do not add or remove a limb. The figure remains fixed to this upright support, with no human lower body, feet, walking stance, floor pedestal, wheels, invented rear machinery or free-standing humanoid form. Only the visible own wall border is included, not a newly invented full rail installation or surrounding architecture. Quiet static neutral pose, no attack, victim, new injury, blood, duplicated target, decal, text, HUD or multiple views. Complete head, all four hands and full existing support within generous at least 8 percent clear margins on all edges. Native detailed original-game-model-style raster, muted original colours, neutral diffuse light. Actual transparent alpha outside the attached wall-target assembly and through any existing open spaces. A single static target transposed for the current stationary versus presentation, not an animation of its rail and not the complete twelve-target puzzle.
